plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Parley Baer is credited on 713 distinct recordings across 36 programs from 1947-07-09 through 1979-07-26. Documented roles include performer on 711 recordings and narrator on 2 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Gunsmoke (performer on 426 recordings; 426 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 77 recordings; 77 distinct recordings), Tales of the Texas Rangers (performer on 25 recordings; 25 distinct recordings), Escape (performer on 21 recordings and narrator on 1 recording; 22 distinct recordings), Sears Radio Theater (performer on 19 recordings; 19 distinct recordings), NBC University Theater (performer on 17 recordings; 17 distinct recordings), This Is Your FBI (performer on 14 recordings; 14 distinct recordings), and The Railroad Hour (performer on 11 recordings; 11 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Chester Proudfoot (426 portrayals).
